THE HOUSE RULES

Small worlds.
Properly considered.

01

Original from the first line

Every Craven & Quill character belongs to its own world. We do not borrow famous faces or redraw other artists’ work.

02

Built around the reader

Choose the reading level, story direction and character likeness before the full personalised book is made.

03

Claims you can check

Sample pages are labelled, planned prices are labelled, and print quality will only be promised after physical proofs pass inspection.

GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you choose a book.

When can I buy the colouring books?+

The first three editions have been submitted to Amazon and are awaiting review. Buying links will replace the “planned” labels as soon as the listings are live.

What do I get in a colouring book?+

Each planned square paperback contains 40 different black-and-white drawings. Artwork is printed on one side, with a blank reverse page. The physical proof must pass before any paper-performance claim is added.

Are the characters original?+

Yes. The ghosts, woodland animals, floral designs and personalised story characters were created for Craven & Quill. They are not based on licensed entertainment characters.

How does a personalised story work?+

An adult chooses a first name, reading age and story, then adds one clear photo. We show one free illustrated page for approval. The rest is only created after the test checkout.

What happens to the photo?+

In this prototype the photo stays in the open browser tab and is not uploaded. Before real orders open, the live service must name its image provider, publish a short deletion period and give parents a clear delete option.

How will delivery and returns work?+

Amazon’s terms will apply to colouring-book orders. Personalised books need their own made-to-order delivery, cancellation and reprint policy. The draft policy links below show the points that must be finalised before checkout opens.
